ios.name: Jevit: Red Flag Chat Analyzer
ios.subtitle: Is he into me? AI text judge
ios.promotionalText: Free AI judge for your chats: upload a screenshot, ask “Is he into me?” or “Who’s right?”, and get a clear answer with red and green flags. Private, no paywall.
ios.reviewNotes: Demo account (no social login needed): on the sign-in screen tap 'Reviewer or tester? Sign in with email' and use the demo credentials provided in the review form. Sign in with Apple also works. Then tap 'Judge a chat': before anything is sent, a consent sheet names the third-party AI (Clef by Cloudflare, and Gemma by Google for translation, both on Cloudflare Workers AI) and what is shared; tap 'I agree, continue' ('Not now' sends nothing). It can be turned off anytime in Account → AI data sharing. Then add a screenshot or paste a chat (example: 'Me: you said 7pm / Him: stop nagging me'), ask 'Am I wrong here?' and tap JUDGE IT. Answers are computed by Cloudflare Workers AI (Clef model). Uploaded content is not stored. Account deletion: Account → Delete account.

android.title: Jevit: Red Flag Chat Analyzer
android.shortDescription: AI chat analyzer: upload a screenshot, spot red flags and see who’s right.

description:
Is he into me? Am I wrong? Is this a red flag? Upload a screenshot of the chat and Jevit, the AI chat analyzer, gives you a clear answer in seconds.

Free, private, and no paywall: you get free answers every day.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Upload the chat: a screenshot from any messaging or dating app, or paste the messages.
2. Ask a question: “Is he cheating?”, “Is she into me?”, “Who’s right, me or them?”, “How toxic is this?”
3. Get the answer: YES, NOPE, YOU WIN or BOTH WRONG, and how sure it is.

A CLEAR ANSWER, NOT AN ESSAY
Jevit’s AI reads every message and checks about 20 things:
• Red flags: low effort, mixed signals, blame-shifting, gaslighting, controlling behavior, love bombing
• Green flags: affection, effort, respect, consistency, good banter
• Their interest in you, how toxic the chat is, and who puts in more effort
• One short piece of advice

FOR DATING, CRUSHES AND ARGUMENTS
Decode a crush’s texts, check a boyfriend or girlfriend chat, settle an argument with a friend, or get a second opinion before you reply.

SHARE THE ANSWER
Turn any answer into a story-ready card and send it to your friends in one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your screenshots are used for one answer and never stored. No ads, no tracking, no selling data. Sign in with Apple or Google keeps bots out.

ANY LANGUAGE
Jevit speaks your phone’s language, and you can ask in any language.

SAFETY FIRST
If a chat shows threats, control, or abuse, Jevit stops joking and points you to real help.

Jevit is for fun. Answers come from AI, can be wrong, and are not psychological, relationship, or legal advice.

Privacy: https://jevit.fun/privacy
Terms: https://jevit.fun/terms
